nodes.title: The database pool logs a lost idle connection and carries on: createPool() attaches pool.on('error'); pg has already dropped the dead client, so the next query opens a fresh connection and the control plane stays up through a Postgres restart
nodes.rationale: Staging 2026-10-24 06:25 UTC: an unattended-upgrade restart of PostgreSQL emitted an idle client's 'terminating connection due to administrator command' on a pool with no listener; Node treated it as unhandled and the control plane exited (systemd restarted it 3 s later, dropping in-flight requests). tests/db-pool.test.ts kills an idle backend with pg_terminate_backend: without the listener the test process dies with an uncaughtException; with it the error is logged and SELECT 1 succeeds.
nodes.reverse_if: A supervisor-level policy (crash and restart on any database error) is chosen deliberately, with in-flight requests drained first; then the listener should rethrow after logging.

events.details: Integrator folded in the staging re-measure attempt: staging redeployed at 6b0d859, VM needrestart list-only and no auto-reboot; the re-measure did not run because the workspace's daily test budget (Rs 200 per IST day, Rs 150.18 spent by the e9fdde3 job) refuses every test call until 18:30 UTC, and the agent correctly did not bypass it. drive7.sh is ready (24 calls, about Rs 73, stops before Rs 120). The control-plane crash on a Postgres restart is fixed in db.ts with a test that fails without the fix.
